scope: Synthetic one-parameter calibration and held-out comparison verification; no physical accuracy claim.

tests.name: Known global leakage multiplier recovered from independent synthetic operating cases
Held-out new operating case improves without participating in fit
Metric sign and RMSE reflect observed minus predicted
Calibration and holdout reject reuse of whole run identity
Distinct run IDs may legitimately reuse relative timestamps
Balanced network rejects unidentifiable leakage fit
Differential endpoint observations use Pplus minus Pminus
Out-of-bound optimum is flagged instead of claiming a trusted estimate
Invalid pressure, endpoint, uncertainty, operating flows and duplicate time rejected
Fitting never changes caller config or source measurements
Simple UI wrapper recovers baseline scale and reports unverified import provenance
